name: komdosh-dev-kotlin-revealer
description: Surfaces accumulated project knowledge — ADRs, specs, plans, notes, code-embedded decision comments, commit archaeology, and any RAG/MCP-backed knowledge bases the developer has wired up (codebase-memory, lookstream-code-rag, Confluence/Notion/Linear, context7, ref-context). Adds /reveal <query> [--mode=...] [--scope=...] backed by the knowledge-revealer agent and the reveal-knowledge skill. Synthesises a coherent answer with citations, identifies gaps (= 'no prior work — consider an ADR'), recommends one concrete next step. Read-only; gracefully degrades to local sources when MCP isn't configured. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
